title: Add independent review of the squash-chain landing design
summary: Write an independent critical review of docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md. Check it against the gate code, landing tests and decisions.md. Save it in docs/design/reviews/ following the existing naming, and change no code.

defaults_applied.how: Every finding cites the file and section it rests on.
The review is written for an outside reader.
The verifier checks that only docs changed and that cargo test passes.

assumptions: Naming follows the existing <design>-review-N.md convention, so the file is squash-chain-landing-review-1.md.
The review is read-only with respect to code, config and records.
The paths jobs.rs, invariant.rs, landing_tests.rs and docs/decisions.md are as in the earlier reading; I did not verify them.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new file docs/design/reviews/squash-chain-landing-review-1.md exists, following the naming of the other files in docs/design/reviews/, written for an outside reader.
Each finding cites a specific section of docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md plus the related code (crates/athena-gate/src/jobs.rs, invariant.rs, landing_tests.rs) or a docs/decisions.md entry.
Each finding has a severity, evidence, and a recommended change. The review ends with a verdict: approve, approve with changes, or reject.
The review checks whether the design's claims match what the code and landing_tests.rs do, and lists untested failure modes.
Run `git status` and `git diff`: only files under docs/ changed and the only new file is the review. Run `cargo test` to confirm nothing broke.

out_of_scope: Changing code, tests, config or records
Fixing the issues the review finds
